title: Elon Musk's SpaceX may buy Boost Mobile to make Starlink into a full-fledged carrier
summary: SpaceX has made no secret of its plans to turn Starlink Mobile into a full-fledged US carrier, and last month it bought more spectrum to help make that happen. What it still lacks is a ground network, and last week T-Mobile's CEO ruled out letting Starlink Mobile run on his company's network. Now, …
